notes.note: 30 disposals for Gulden with 11 contested as he was the best scorer for the Swans on the night. He is looking like he is back to his best.
Gulden had the 27 disposals but his disposal efficiency was down. He continues to get cheaper but unless his scoring rises soon he isn't one that you want to bring in just yet.

Gulden returned after the long lay off since round 1. He played 77% time on ground and had 18 disposals but just 44% efficiency. Certainly one to watch but maybe just hold off another week as he has a BE of 151
Gulden looks set to be returning following the bye according to coach Dean Cox.
Gulden was having a great game before he injured his shoulder in the last term. He is going to miss for 4 months so a must trade.
Gulden was at the top of a lot of shopping lists and this just cemented that. He was the one that really got the Swans going after half time.
